answer: Give every new agent identity a tight rate limit that loosens only with age and clean history, like a willow climbing a trellis one notch per season. A Sybil farm can spawn a thousand fresh accounts, but each starts on tundra-thin quotas: a few transactions per day, no grading seats. To act at scale the attacker must keep every fake alive and well-behaved for months, paying upkeep while each identity yields almost nothing.
